name: EPIC 214606859
description: A red giant in K2 campaign 7, 21.1 solar radii and 1.82 solar masses, weighed by its oscillations.

text.card: A red giant 8,673 parsecs away, 21 times the Sun's width, weighed by its starquakes.
text.introduction: Its oscillations, recorded in K2 campaign 7, give 1.82 solar masses and 21.1 solar radii; GALAH spectra give 4,676 K at its surface.
